name: @vsslicer/webview-kit
description: Webview plumbing shared by VSSlicer extensions: host (Node), webview and gl (browser) entry points and the transport schema version.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.host.json && tsc -p tsconfig.webview.json && tsc -p tsconfig.gl.json && tsc -p tsconfig.testing.json
scripts.test: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && pnpm build && vitest run
scripts.test:integration: esbuild test/integration/webview.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --target=es2023 --banner:js="// SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later" --outfile=test/integration/fixture/webview.js && esbuild test/integration/*.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --banner:js="// SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later" --external:vscode --outdir=test/integration/fixture/tests && vsslicer-test-vscode --extension test/integration/fixture --tests test/integration/fixture/tests
